name: Ribosomal Translation, Genetic Code Fidelity, and Ubiquitin-Proteasome Degradation

reference.source: Medical Biochemistry 5th ed / Lehninger Principles of Biochemistry 8th ed
clinicalPearls: Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases ensure genetic code fidelity through hydrolytic proofreading of misactivated amino acids
Peptidyl transferase is an intrinsic 28S rRNA ribozyme within the 60S large ribosomal subunit
Diphtheria toxin and Pseudomonas exotoxin A inactivate eukaryotic EF-2 via ADP-ribosylation
Targeted proteolysis requires covalent polyubiquitination (E1-E2-E3 cascade) directing substrates to the 26S proteasome
Bortezomib is a selective 26S proteasome inhibitor that induces apoptotic death in multiple myeloma plasma cells
reference.pathophysiology: Translation decodes mRNA into polypeptides on 80S cytoplasmic ribosomes through initiation, elongation, and termination cycles. Diphtheria toxin ADP-ribosylates a unique diphthamide residue on eEF2, arresting translocation. Proteostasis requires continuous ubiquitin-mediated destruction of damaged or regulatory proteins; proteasome blockade leads to toxic intracellular misfolded protein aggregation and apoptosis.
additionalDifferentials: Multiple myeloma and plasma cell dyscrasias
Respiratory diphtheria (membranous pharyngitis with systemic toxin toxicity)
Pseudomonas aeruginosa severe sepsis (exotoxin A mediated)
additionalInvestigations: Serum protein electrophoresis (SPEP) and immunofixation for monoclonal paraproteins
Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy for clonal plasma cell infiltration (>10%)
Elek immunodiffusion test or PCR for toxigenic Corynebacterium diphtheriae
